title: Residual detuning in the laboratory-frame anti-Jaynes--Cummings model with a squeezed vacuum
summary: The laboratory-frame anti-Jaynes--Cummings (AJC) interaction retains a residual detuning $2fλ$ that is absent from the rotating-frame model. We map two proposed remedies---a Kerr shift $χ(\hat a^\dagger\hat a)^2$ and collective Dicke coupling of $N$ two-level emitters---for a squeezed vacuum on that ladder ($r=1$, $\langle n\rangle=\sinh^2 r\simeq 1.38$). All quoted contrasts are the amplitude of the first turning point of the atomic ground-state population, which coincides with the two-level formula $\mathcal{C}=1/[1+(2f+χ)^2]$ at $r=0$ to $10^{-9}$.
